summary: The phrase 'six standing ecosystem rulings' conflates three taxonomy-session items described as made or proposed with three decisions that remained owed. The supplied foundation-process captures do not establish ratification of those items. Selective migration requires explicit human adoption and durable provenance; proceeding with implementation is not treated as approval.
completed_work: Recovered the taxonomy-session six-item structure from a user-supplied Claude reconstruction: three items described as made or proposed and three explicitly unresolved decisions.
Made/proposed item 1 — Maxai authority sentence: 'Maxai may name the role and interface of human review; the ledger's authority field always records the actual human.'

Made/proposed item 2 — Domain split: fieldmouth.com hosts the standard; fieldmouthai.com hosts the product. The source reconstruction itself says this was a recommendation to an open question and was not verbally ratified.

Made/proposed item 3 — The Record adoption with four conditions: CI-enforced validation and negative fixtures; Bolt proposes through PR and only a human merges; evidence uses sha256 artifacts plus spans; Constitution preserves migration-not-abandonment and continuity-not-ledger boundaries.
Owed decision 1 — Sidecar: embed the envelope in a fenced block in Markdown exports or ship a sidecar JSON file.
Owed decision 2 — Benchmark identity fork from the TR-001 workstream.
Owed decision 3 — Register TR-000 in the registry.
Distinguished implementation evidence from approval evidence: implementation and proceeding do not constitute a human canon act.
Audited three supplied ChatVault captures covering foundation bootstrapping, control architecture, and independent branch review; none contains an authoritative six-ruling list.
Confirmed all three captures are marked captured_not_reviewed and once_snapshot_visible_only, so they are source artifacts rather than approved truth.

Resolve the Sidecar, benchmark identity fork, and TR-000 registration questions through future human decisions; do not migrate them as completed rulings.

Do not treat the three foundation-process captures as approval evidence for the taxonomy-session items.
